notes.title: ♦️ New Demo Update!
notes.notes:
🎪 Hello! We’ve been working on some additions recently, and we decided to update the demo version with some of them.


Unfortunately, since translations are still being developed and implemented, they will NOT be included in this update.

Additions:
New gate mechanic

New trap mechanic

Updated 3D model and textures of the house


Changes:
Relocation of some traps

Small changes to the environment

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.notes:
Hello, this is a small update based on feedback and analysis of gameplays from several different sources.

If you have any feedbacks, please, feel free to share with us. Thank you. 🎪


🔴 Changes:  
Decreased amount of Batteries in the scenario.  

Decrease in the amount of Sneakers in the scenario.  

Slight decrease in the amount of stamina received by Sneakers.  

Removal of some gates.    


🔴 Corrections:  
The flashlight sprite in the HUD now moves when “headbob” is disabled in the options.    


🔴 Additions:  
Hall access after the completion of the stage.

Addition of an objective progress bar in the HUD.
